experiment_1_odin_inversion.description: ODIN tier inversion test — does T1+T2 actually beat T3+T4 for options? Hypothesis: option premium pays for uncertainty, not quality.

experiment_2_stage_cap_outcome.description: Where does the Phase 1/2 positive-readout edge live? Breakout by cap_tier and outcome.

experiment_3_iv_cheapness_quintile.description: IV cheapness quintile test. Hypothesis: buying cheap IV (Q1) beats buying expensive IV (Q5).

experiment_4_oi_liquidity.description: Open interest liquidity buckets. Hypothesis: OI >= 100 is fillable at mid; OI < 50 is fantasy.

experiment_5_regime_split.description: Regime split: 2022–2023 (ZIRP exit, IV crush era) vs 2024–2026 (higher-vol regime, biotech recovery).

experiment_6_spread_discipline.description: Spread discipline. Hypothesis: tight spreads (<=10%) retain more edge than wide ones; wide spreads still make money on the outlier positives.

experiment_7_iv_change_quintile.description: IV-change quintile. Q1 = most crush, Q5 = biggest expansion. Tests whether positioning before IV expansion is the dominant option edge.

experiment_8_compound_playbooks.description: Compound filter playbooks — the candidate v1.3 live-trading rules.
